description: This file defines the Wishlist model class for the Opencart e-commerce platform, providing methods to add, delete, retrieve, and count customer wishlists in the database.

classes.name: Wishlist
classes.description: Model class for managing customer wishlists, including adding, deleting, retrieving, and counting wishlist entries.

methods.name: addWishlist
methods.description: Creates or updates a customer wishlist record in the database by deleting existing entries for the customer and inserting a new one with the current date.

methods.name: deleteWishlists
methods.description: Deletes wishlist records for a customer, optionally filtering by product ID.

methods.name: getWishlist
methods.description: Retrieves all wishlist records for a specific customer.

methods.name: getTotalWishlist
methods.description: Returns the total number of wishlist records for a customer.
